Check out this Cricket Stretch Routine you Need To Try as part of your Cricket Fitness Training Plan.
• Hold Each Stretch Position for around 60 seconds with smooth controlled breath through the stretch.
Improving your Flexibility is one of the most powerful things you can do to improve your Cricket Performance (and has some of the quickest results)
This is due to the increase range of movement you get with increased flexibility.
But it can also help to reduce your chance of injury during cricket matches or cricket training sessions.
